evidence: Risks associated with the use of AI in our business operations, including regulatory, data privacy, cybersecurity, E&O, intellectual property and competition risks;

The use of this technology by our clients or underwriting enterprises may impact the way our business operates, and its use by our competitors and new market entrants with competing services derived from their AI capabilities may give them a competitive advantage.
The rapid development of these technologies may require significant efforts to upskill or reskill existing employees.
The risk from threat actors has increased due to the rapid development of AI capabilities.
ai_positioning.summary: AJG est prudent face aux risques liés à l'utilisation de l'IA, notamment en termes de réglementation, de confidentialité des données et de cybersécurité.
